question: As per the Budget 2022 announcement, a _______ income tax will be applied on earnings from virtual digital assets like cryptocurrencies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**30%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Union Budget 2022**: **Sitharaman **said that there has been a tremendous **increase **in the use of **virtual digital assets **and it requires a specific **tax regime**.
 
• Despite the government not introducing the much-awaited **cryptocurrency bill **in the **Union Budget 2022-23**, the **Union Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman **announced that any **income **from the **transfer of virtual digital assets **will be **taxed at 30 percent**.
 
• This year’s **Budget **address was noteworthy on many counts as it was the **shortest address **by **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman **in **4 years**. 
 
• Besides this, the finance minister also announced the introduction of central bank digital currency, popularly known as **CBDCs**, powered by **blockchain technology in 2022-23**.
 
• **The digital currency will be introduced by the Reserve Bank of India.**
